title: Circadian Phase Realignment & Sleep Debt Countermeasure
plain_language_summary: Autonomous operational protocol for astronauts exhibiting cumulative sleep deficit, circadian phase drift, or elevated psychomotor response latency in deep space confinement.
crew_instructions: Verify sleep cabin environmental parameters: set ambient acoustic masking to 45 dBA and cabin temperature to 18-19°C.
Enforce dynamic blue-depleted lighting protocol (460 nm notch filtered) beginning 120 minutes prior to scheduled sleep onset.
Restrict strenuous aerobic or high-intensity resistive exercise to at least 3 hours prior to sleep window.
Avoid non-essential mission tasks during circadian nadir (MET 02:00 - 06:00 equivalent).
Perform 15-minute pre-sleep guided relaxation / autogenic breathing sequence via personal crew terminal.
Administer scheduled physiological monitoring: wearable actigraphy, sleep duration log, and 3-minute morning Psychomotor Vigilance Task (PVT).

safety_limits.pvt_lapse_threshold: Maximum 3 lapses (>500ms) before dual-crew crosscheck required for critical flight operations

de_escalation_criteria: Two consecutive sleep cycles with sleep efficiency >= 85%, sleep duration >= 7.0 hours, and PVT median reaction time < 260 ms.
